create_atoms_sequence_protocol: create a class that implements the AtomsSequence protocol with __getitem__ and __len__ methods
wrap_dataset_with_atoms_dataset_sequence: wrap an AseAtomsDataset with AtomsDatasetSequence to iterate over atoms objects by index
index_atoms_from_dataset_sequence: index an AtomsDatasetSequence with an integer to retrieve a single Atoms object from the dataset
get_length_of_atoms_dataset_sequence: get the length of an AtomsDatasetSequence by calling len on the wrapped dataset
check_atoms_sequence_conformance: use isinstance to check at runtime if an object conforms to the AtomsSequence protocol
